ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: This section for Chancellor's Scholars only; others may only enroll with the approval of the instructor and the Campus Honors Program. Contemporary visual culture. Introduction of interdisciplinary methods in recognizing and understanding meaning of a wide range of visual messages in the arts, design, and culture, with emphasis on critical thinking and analysis. Topics including visual perception, visual persuasion, the visual interpretation of time and space, humor, contemporary art and design, and body language as a visual code are explored through use of semiotics (the study of signs) and historical, cultural, ethical, aesthetic, and technical perspectives.
